correctness.rationale: For every n>=2, S_n vertex orbits are weight layers and geometric fixed points are exactly barycenters of unions of admissible whole orbits. The maximum distance between weight classes a,b is min(a+b,2n-a-b), yielding low/high classes and band-graph independence complex Ind(B_m), m=floor(n/2). Open-neighborhood dominations L_{2i+1} by L_{2i}, then R_{2i+1} by R_{2i} validly collapse Ind(B_m) onto Ind(t K2), t=ceil(m/2), a (t-1)-sphere. Complement exchanges incompatible L_i,R_i and has no setwise invariant simplex; reduced Lefschetz trace implies sign (-1)^t on integral rank-one top homology. Complete proof is in RESULT.md. Direct exhaustive original-orbit checks n=2..10, neighborhood folding checks m=1..30 and exact mod-two ranks m=1..6 agree; finite checks are not relied upon for the all-n theorem.

value.rationale: The full symmetric-coordinate fixed-point topology is a natural equivariant invariant for hypercube Rips complexes at the first scale below the known top cross-polytope stage. An explicit collapse yields integral spheres of dimension floor((n-2)/4) for unbounded n; the residual free bit complement has computable integral orientation sign. This bridges difficult unrestricted high-scale homotopy with a uniform geometric fixed-locus classification and is neither a mere finite table nor a generic renaming. Value is limited to the full S_n-fixed space, not to the full complex.
